'''Drearia''' was an [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] situated on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|hyperlane]]. Sharing its name with the [[Drearian Defense Conglomerate/Legends|Drearian Defense Conglomerate]], Drearia was a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and later the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], for which it served as a [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. The world saw [[Battle of Drearia (6 ABY)|two]] [[Battle of Drearia (Pre–Shadow Hand campaign)|clashes]] between Imperial and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and, in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], the [[Mandator III-class dreadnought|''Mandator III''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Aculeus]]'' was [[Battle of Drearia (Imperial Mutiny)|lost]] at Drearia due to [[Imperial Civil War|Imperial in-fighting]].

==Description==
Drearia was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] located in the [[Drearia system/Legends|Drearia system]], a part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. By [[3705 BBY/Legends|3705 BBY]], Drearia was situated between the [[Chagri system|Chagri]] and [[Per Lupelo system/Legends|Per Lupelo systems]] on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]] known as the [[Corsin Run]]. At some point following [[3694 BBY]], the hyperlane was integrated into the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]].<ref name="TEA" /> In addition, a smaller route linked Drearia to the [[Gyrica system/Legends|Gyrica system]].<ref name="EGTW" />

==History==
[[Realspace/Legends|Space]] surrounding Drearia was [[Scout/Legends|explored]] between [[25,000 BBY/Legends|25,000 BBY]] and [[20,000 BBY/Legends|20,000 BBY]]. The world was a part of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] of [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]&ndash;[[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> with both the [[Third Mid Rim Army|Third]] and the [[Seventh Army|Seventh Sector Armies]] of the Republic being charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] in Drearia's vicinity.<ref name="EGTW" /> Drearia shared its name with the weapons manufacturing company [[Drearian Defense Conglomerate/Legends|Drearian Defense Conglomerate]], which had been established at some point by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of that conflict.<ref name="SM">''[[Special Modifications]]''</ref>

[[File:Drearia10ABY-TEA.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Several battles were fought at Drearia as part of the Galactic Civil War.]]
By [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], Drearia fell within the territory controlled by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="EGTW" /> Shortly after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] was fought in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], Drearia served as an Imperial [[Fortress world/Legends|fortress world]]. In [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], the [[New Republic Third Fleet]] prevailed in a [[Battle of Drearia (6 ABY)|battle]] at Drearia against Imperial [[Imperial Military/Legends|forces]] as part of an advance northward along the Hydian Way. The reverse situation occurred [[10 ABY/Legends|four years]] later, when Imperial forces at Drearia were [[Battle of Drearia (Pre–Shadow Hand campaign)|victorious]] over the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] as part of a [[Pre–Shadow Hand campaign|Coreward push]].<ref name="TEA" />

Following the Empire's [[Second Battle of Coruscant|capture]] of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world, [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], during that campaign, Imperial forces engaged in highly-destructive [[Imperial Civil War|in-fighting]] and [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[TIE/D automated starfighter]]s caused the destruction of the [[Mandator III-class dreadnought|''Mandator III''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Aculeus]]''. By [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], Drearia was situated within the borders of the New Republic.<ref name="EGTW" /> Around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the world's population numbered between one and ten billion.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
Drearia was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-8.<ref name="TEA" />
